rows.why: He said ليل (night-time) for 'last night'; Amal said ليلة at the same second he restarted with ليلة, so it reads as her recast (not a clear self-fix before her).

Noun + adjective phrase needs el- on both (el-shahar el-maadi, as her chat types it); not voiced.
